initial_common_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square Cafe Collection collectible card artwork, single image, no card border. Photograph an ordinary local drink on a worn dark walnut cafe table inside an old dim European cafe at night. Dark wood, a softly blurred amber table lamp, deep brown shadows, a hint of aged green upholstery. Quiet unpretentious atmosphere, fine film grain, realistic glass and condensation, rich but restrained colors, no bright daylight or outdoor view. Close three-quarter view, full vessel visible with comfortable space around it, main drink roughly 55 to 65 percent of frame height, focus on the drink, shallow depth of field. The beverage's real color must remain legible under the warm light. No people, no hands, no decorative food spread, no text overlay, no captions, no watermark. Any bottle label should be turned away or blank, with no invented lettering. One drink serving, not a collage.
